modes.label: Toasted sandwich
modes.blurb: Pick a bread and 7 fillings, get 3 toasties
intro: {starter} picks the bread first, then you take turns adding fillings — 4 picks each.
The chef makes three toasted sandwiches with your bread.

conceptText: Two friends played a cooking game and drafted the ingredients for a TOASTED SANDWICH: one bread and {n} fillings (the JSON below). Invent THREE different toasted sandwiches from them.

Every idea is a CLOSED TOASTED SANDWICH: two pieces of the chosen bread ({bread}, id "{bread_id}") on the outside, the fillings inside, toasted until golden and hot right through. Never an open sandwich, a wrap, a salad, a bake where the bread is cubed or crumbed, or a dish with the bread on the side.
- Use the bread in all three ideas and name it in each title or description.

- Try hard to use every filling in every idea. Each idea must use at least {each} of the {n} fillings, at least one idea must use {best} or more, and between them the three ideas must use all {n}. Leave a filling out only when it would really clash, and say why in "omitted".
- Give each idea a different "build" from this list: {build_list}.

- Butter is always allowed (list "butter" in stapleIds when you use it); salt, black pepper and water are free. You may also use at most TWO of: plain flour, cooking oil, granulated sugar, milk. Nothing else that is not in the basket.
- Surprising fillings are part of the fun: make them taste good together.
chef.recipeText: This is the full recipe for one toasted sandwich idea, for two people (two sandwiches). Keep the bread on the outside and make it the "{build_label}" way: {build_phrase}. Butter is always allowed.
chef.styleLine: The style flavours the toasted sandwiches; every idea is still a closed toasted sandwich.
